Assertions.Description: Enable through Settings and activate the current shortcut from a normal-user owned foreground scene; observe the overlay.
Escape closes all overlays and leaves the clipboard unchanged.
The same shortcut reopens the overlay after Escape.
Right-click the selection surface and choose Cancel; all overlays close without changing the clipboard.
After proven shortcut activation, disable through Settings; UI and persisted enabled state are off and the same shortcut does not open the overlay.
Re-enable through Settings and observe successful activation; restore original enablement.
The enabled module's existing show event opens an overlay that can be dismissed; this is not keyboard-binding evidence.
Select rendered PowerToys Text Extractor; clipboard contains those words in order and the overlay closes.
Click the rendered PowerToys word; only that word is copied and the overlay closes.
Capture a blank owned region; no clipboard change, recoverable no-text message, and overlay remains open.
Single-line capture joins both rendered lines in order without line breaks.
Table capture preserves two rendered rows and tab-separated columns in a clearly spaced two-column fixture.
S changes the single-line toolbar toggle; a second S restores its initial value.
T changes the table toolbar toggle; a second T restores its initial value.
While dragging, Shift-movement translates the selected region without resizing before capture.
Escape during a drag closes overlays, copies nothing, and restores the original cursor clipping bounds.
The crosshair remains visible while moving through the selection interior, excluding toolbar and display edges.
On WinUI builds, the blank-capture error appears below every toolbar control without overlap.
After blank capture and without refocusing, S, T and every available language number among 1-9 change the corresponding state; cancellation remains usable.
With at least two OCR languages, a right-click language change updates checked menu and toolbar state and recognizes a known sample in the selected language.
With at least two OCR languages, change the toolbar language and verify the context-menu checked item agrees.
For every installed OCR language among the first nine, press its displayed number shortcut and observe the corresponding selected language.
With multiple monitors, capture owned known text separately on every monitor and verify the words.
With multiple monitors at different DPI, verify capture on each, recording physical bounds and scale separately.
With a negative-origin display, verify correct text capture on that display.
With multiple overlays open, change language and formatting on one monitor and observe synchronized state on every other overlay.
Save a collision-checked temporary shortcut through Settings; verify persisted code and all modifiers.
The saved temporary shortcut activates the overlay.
The former shortcut does not activate after the replacement is saved.
Restore the exact original shortcut through the recorder and verify activation.
With a second installed OCR language, change the Settings preference and verify the persisted native language name.
A new overlay starts in the new preferred language and captures a known sample correctly.
Restore the original preference; a fresh overlay uses that preference or the documented input-language fallback.
On WinUI builds, the toolbar Settings button closes overlays and opens the Text Extractor Settings page.
On WinUI builds, the right-click Settings item closes overlays and opens the Text Extractor Settings page.
With the installed PowerToys extension available, invoke its Text Extractor activation command and observe the overlay.
Invoke the extension's Text Extractor settings command and observe the correct Settings page.
While Text Extractor is disabled, its activation command is unavailable but its settings command remains available; restore original state.
With non-English Settings UI on a build containing localizable attribution links, inspect the localized label and open Text-Grab in an owned browser tab; restore tab/language/Settings state.
In light Windows app theme, inspect toolbar, context menu and error text for readable, unclipped, nonoverlapping controls.
In dark Windows app theme, inspect toolbar, context menu and error text for readable, unclipped, nonoverlapping controls.
With installed non-English UI, inspect translated overlay labels, tooltips and error text; resource keys must not appear.

In an authorized diagnostic-data environment, enable Diagnostic data and Enable viewing before a controlled restart, then verify invocation/cancellation/capture events from owned actions in Diagnostic data viewer and restore original settings.
In an authorized disposable policy fixture, forced-disabled Text Extractor cannot be enabled or activated; restore exact original policy state.
In an authorized disposable policy fixture, forced-enabled Text Extractor cannot be disabled and can activate; restore exact original policy state.
